migrations.risk: Additive owner-keyed private message storage and two indexes. Reads and writes are scoped to the authenticated internal user id. Account erasure explicitly deletes these rows. A missing migration leaves the feature unavailable.
migrations.rollbackPlan: Disable the feature through existing conversation controls. Before any future table drop, export each account's messages or obtain explicit data-discard authorization; production migration execution requires a separate backup and execution receipt.
postconditions: personal_chat_messages has a primary key, required owner/body/idempotency/timestamp columns, and an owner foreign key to users
The owner/request id index is unique and the owner/created index supports stable pagination
Request hashes are constrained to 64 characters
